title: PS5 passes 100 million consoles sold 🎮
subject: ps5
description:
Did you buy a PS5 at launch or later? 👇

Sony's Business Data & Sales page now lists the PlayStation 5 at more than 100 million units sold as of November 10, 2026, making it the fourth Sony home console to pass the mark after PS1, PS2 and PS4.

Sources: Sony Interactive Entertainment Business Data & Sales (Nov 10, 2026), Push Square (Nov 11, 2026), Shacknews (Nov 10, 2026)

scenes.text: The PS5 has now sold over 100 million consoles.
Sony confirmed it on November 10, two days before the console turns 6.
About 2.1 million sold after September 30 alone.
Only three Sony home consoles got there first: the original PlayStation, the PS2 and the PS4.
The PS4 hit the mark slightly faster and sits at 117 million. The PS2 still leads with 160 million.
Push Square expects GTA 6, out November 19, to push PS5 sales even higher.
